title: Associating Trajectories with Quantum Processes by Equivalent Spectra
summary: Quantum mechanics abandoned the classical notion of a particle trajectory, yet trajectories remain conceptually appealing for resolving foundational issues in quantum mechanics. Bohmian mechanics offers one route to associating trajectories with quantum processes, but it requires explicit non-locality to remain consistent with EPR-type experiments, placing it in tension with special relativity.
